title: Waitlist
description: Ask to be told when Stranger Thoughts opens. The form starts an email to a placeholder address. It does not take payment or a manuscript.
intro: Version one is a waitlist. The desk is not accepting paid work, manuscripts, or mail. Joining means you want to hear when a real submission path opens.
Nothing on this form is posted to a server. Submitting it opens an email in your own mail app. The direct address below does the same thing with an empty letter.
form_heading: Tell the desk what you are holding
form_note: All three fields are required. Describe the page. Do not paste the whole piece.
subject: Stranger Thoughts waitlist

fields.name: piece
fields.label: What you would send
fields.help: A few sentences on the kind of page, and what you hope a stranger notices. This is a description, not the submission.
fields.placeholder: A letter I have been revising. I want a stranger to notice the ending.

after: When a real mailbox replaces the placeholder, this page will say so in the address block above. Until then, treat the waitlist as a draft of the door.
